plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs: SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU.
We will trim SPY to 20% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
We will add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 25% for income and stability.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and concentrating on income and broad index exposure. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns.

plan: We will trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, MUU to 3%, and METU to 2% to reduce overall leverage.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to comply with the single-name concentration mandate.
We will buy DDOG at 4% allocation, as it is a strong scanner setup.
This plan balances growth with risk management, maintaining a small leveraged ETF presence.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality new name. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

plan: We will add to SOXL (7%), MUU (6%), METU (6%), and SPAL (6%) to lean into leveraged exposure.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
We will buy DDOG at 6% allocation, leveraging a strong scanner setup.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay/rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage higher risk.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs: SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU.
We will trim SPY to 20% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
We will add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, aiming to park cash for yield. It significantly reduces high-beta and leveraged exposure, favoring income and broad index ETFs. While prioritizing low drawdown and distributions, remember distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
